text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a short-term parking area at the north end of Wilson Heights Boulevard. The proposed short-term parking area will assist pick-up/drop-off activity for a daycare centre located at 777 Wilson Heights Boulevard. This designation will not adversely impact traffic or parking operations on Wilson Heights Boulevard.
